_generatedMarkerComment: A markdown file whose HEAD carries this marker is written by a SCRIPT and is
never stamped (open action OA-096). A generated report and a stamp fight each
other: the hook inserts a stamp, the next run of the generator deletes it, the
hook puts it back, and the file churns in every diff while its version number
describes nothing. Keyed on the file CONTENT rather than another entry in
excludeGlobs, so that the next generated report is excluded by its author
saying it is generated -- on the day it is written -- rather than by somebody
remembering to teach this file a new filename. Read from the first 40 lines
only, so a document that merely DISCUSSES generated reports does not exclude
_comment: Which documents docstamp maintains a version + date stamp in.
Scope is deliberately narrow: Markdown and PowerPoint, bus-system folders only.
Anything GENERATED is excluded - the stage pipeline versions its own output by folder
name (S4-generate/v1.3_2026-07-19_0517) and stamps its reports in the body, and the
portal's rendered sheets sit under a byte-identical gate. Never stamp those.
Note: excludeGlobs use fnmatch, where '*' also matches '/'.
'worktrees' is excluded because excludeGlobs are relative to the root, so a
git worktree under .claude/worktrees/<name>/ defeated them: the _gtfs reports
were being stamped there in August 2026 despite the glob above. It also stopped
49 of 141 in-scope documents being duplicate copies of the other 92.
'_archive' is excluded because archived plans are a record, not a live document.
It is on BOTH the buses and portal roots: the portal grew a docs/_archive on
2026-08-18 (PR #41) and without the exclusion those three superseded docs would
be re-stamped forever — a PR each, in the one repo where every commit costs one.
checkoutDirNames is what a root is CALLED when the same repository is checked
out somewhere else. CI puts buses-data at $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/buses-data, which
matches no path above and never will, so check_committed_stamps.py had no
exclusions to apply and audited _archive. That stayed green only because
archiving is a pure git mv: the day a round repointed the links inside nine
documents it was archiving, CI went red about nine files docstamp refuses to
stamp. Added 2026-08-31.
_baselineComment: Directories that are never a document in ANY repository. Every root inherits
these; a root's own excludeDirNames holds only what is local to it. Two kinds of
reason live here and it matters which: .git, node_modules, dist, coverage and
build are NOT DOCUMENTS; worktrees and scratch are NOT OURS TO WRITE TO -- a
worktree is full of real documents and the objection is ownership. Added
2026-09-04 for buses-data OA-235, after the three roots had drifted to lists
sharing only .git: 60 of the portal root's 90 markdown files were inside
worktrees, and two sessions running --all stamped each other's in-flight work.
